title: Configuration Run Read Problems
description: Closed RFC 9457 problem documents (application/problem+json) of the configuration run measurement and status reads. Each definition is one fixed status and code with fixed title and detail; nothing the client sent is echoed. NotFoundProblem (404, not_found) is the one answer for a missing, foreign, ungranted or wrong-parent configuration run: identical bytes in every case. BadRequestProblem (400, bad_request) is a query parameter that fails its declared format or range: a limit out of range, or a cursor that does not match the declared token format, or an unknown query parameter. InvalidCursorProblem (400, invalid_cursor) is a well-formed cursor that cannot be used: the stored results changed since it was issued, or it belongs to another configuration run or page shape.

detail.const: The request could not be processed.

BadRequestProblem.description: A query parameter fails its declared format or range (limit out of range, a cursor that does not match the declared token format) or is not declared.

detail.const: The cursor is not valid for this request.

InvalidCursorProblem.description: A well-formed cursor that cannot be used: the stored results changed since it was issued, or it belongs to another configuration run or page shape.

detail.const: The requested resource was not found.

NotFoundProblem.description: The configuration run is missing, foreign, ungranted or outside the named parent; identical bytes in every case.
